votes.motion: Commissioner Hawker moved to APPROVE the request for Deviations for a reduced landscape perimeter on the north side of the property with number 1 and 5 of DCMC Section 9-23-030(B) being met, as requested by Glen Goins, representing Steve Hutchings, Application VAR-064-2023, subject to the following: Findings: 1. The deviation is consistent with the purpose of this chapter and any applicant's master plan or ordinance. 2. The deviation is justified by site constraints. 3. We find that the applicant meets the findings for Section 9-23-030(B) number 1

Commissioner Squire moved to APPROVE the Deviation request for cross access on the north side of the property as requested by Glen Goins, representing Steve Hutchings, Application VAR-064-2023 subject to the following: Findings: 1. Access from the adjoining property was not previously designed or required to provide reciprocal cross-access to the subject property. 2. Site improvements on the adjoining property physically impede the ability to create a cross-access drive between both properties. 3. We find that the applicant meets the cross-access deviation in Section 9-25-080 (E)(2), (D)(1), a

Commissioner Fowler moved to APPROVE the Site Plan as requested by Glen Goins, representing Steve Hutchings, Application SPR-016-2023, subject to the following: Findings: 1. The site plan reflects the full development of the property. 2. The site plan conforms to applicable standards set forth in this title, including but not limited to, building heights, setbacks, access points, parking, landscaping, and building materials. 3. The proposed development plans meet the intent, goals, and objectives of the general plan and the purpose of the zoning district in which the site is located
